features: Production-to-dissipation ratio: >1 marks non-equilibrium separated shear layers where SST anisotropy is wrong.
Turbulent length over wall distance: high near-wall, low in free shear to separate near-wall vs wake correction.
Turbulence intensity bounded 0-1: ~1 in low-speed recirculation bubble where SST anisotropy fails, ~0 in high-speed attached flow.
Pressure-gradient vs shear-rate force balance: high in APG separation and bump leading edge, low in attached shear.
Normalized k-gradient marks edge of separated shear layer and reattachment transport vs equilibrium core.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 features checked dimensionless in L-T (U:L/T,k:L2/T2,omega:1/T,eps:L2/T3,d:L,S/W:1/T,UgradP:L2/T3,gradp irrelevant). Denominators use k*Umag (cell-center >0), eps>0, Snorm+omega>0 so finite on >99% off-wall points; wall 0/0 risk minimal as d>0 at centers. Ordering only matters due to median normalization. Risks: f_apg_dist large in stagnation; f_noneq correlates with I1 in equilibrium but diverges in separation shear; f_curv overlaps I1/I2 partially but adds omega timescale for curvature/APG separation on bumps.

features.name: f_apg_dist
features.rationale: Signed adverse pressure gradient scaled by wall distance over k: positive marks APG/deceleration upstream of bump separation.

features.name: f_noneq
features.rationale: Production-to-dissipation ratio: >1 marks non-equilibrium separated shear layers where SST anisotropy is wrong.

features.name: f_curv
features.rationale: Rotation vs strain plus turbulence rate: detects streamline curvature and vortical separation over bumps vs pure shear.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 checked dimensionless under V->2V L->3L: UgradK/eps ~ (8/3)/(8/3), d*Snorm/(Umag+sqrt(k)) ~2/2, UgradP/(eps+Umag*DUDt) ~(8/3)/(8/3). Finite: eps>0 so adv and apg_acc denominators >0; shear denominator Umag+sqrt(k)>0 off-wall (>99% points). Orthogonal to I1/I2 (which are S,W scaled) and to f_noneq: add k-advection, wall-scaled shear, APG-vs-acceleration for converging-diverging worst heldout 0.55. Drop f_curv (gain -0.0071, redundant with I1/I2) and f_apg_dist (gain 0.0, unused).

features.name: f_adv_k
features.rationale: Streamwise advection of k vs dissipation: signed transport marks upstream/downstream of separation and reattachment where local Pk/eps fails.

features.name: f_shear_wall
features.rationale: Wall-distance-scaled shear vs local velocity scale: high near-wall/separated shear layer, low in freestream, separates near-wall vs free shear.

features.name: f_apg_acc
features.rationale: Signed APG normalized by dissipation plus acceleration magnitude: distinguishes decelerating APG separation in diffuser from accelerating FPG in contraction.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 checked dimensionless under U->2U L->3L: f_curv (1/T)/(1/T); f_apg_prod (L2/T3)/((1/T)*(L2/T2)); f_len_wall (L/T)/((1/T)*L). Finite: f_curv denom=W+S+omega>0 always (omega>0) so 100% finite and bounded; f_apg_prod denom=(S+omega)>0 times (k+Umag2)>0 except exact wall 0/0, cell-centers >0 so >99% finite, signed ordering APG+/FPG-; f_len_wall denom omega*d>0 off-wall, only exact wall d=0 singular (<1% points). Distinct from f_noneq (Pk/eps): curvature, signed APG work, and lt/d wall-vs-free add orthogonal orderings for bumps/curvature and diffuser APG/FPG; drop f_adv_k/f_shear_wall/f_apg_acc with gain<=0 to free slots despite f_shear_wall use, as gain negative implies heldout harm.

features.name: f_curv_strain
features.rationale: Rotation vs strain with omega floor: positive marks curvature/vortex-dominated bubble, negative marks attached shear.

features.name: f_apg_prod
features.rationale: Signed pressure work vs kinetic energy times shear rate: +APG deceleration (diffuser/bump separation) vs -FPG acceleration (contraction).

features.name: f_len_wall
features.rationale: Turbulent length over wall distance: high near-wall, low in free shear to separate near-wall vs wake correction.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 formulas checked dimensionless (L/T2 vs L/T2, L/T vs L/T); denominators are sums of same-unit positive terms so zero only when both parts vanish (wall/stagnation <1% points, bounded 0-1 so tanh-like mapping preserves ordering); f_sep_int marks recirculation, f_pg_bal marks APG/FPG dominance distinct from failed f_apg_prod magnitude, f_tke_edge marks shear-layer edge distinct from f_noneq; drop only unused zero-gain features, keep f_len_wall (terms_using=1, gain -0.0005 within noise) to avoid regressing best formula.

features.name: f_sep_int
features.rationale: Turbulence intensity bounded 0-1: ~1 in low-speed recirculation bubble where SST anisotropy fails, ~0 in high-speed attached flow.

features.name: f_pg_bal
features.rationale: Pressure-gradient vs shear-rate force balance: high in APG separation and bump leading edge, low in attached shear.

features.name: f_tke_edge
features.rationale: Normalized k-gradient marks edge of separated shear layer and reattachment transport vs equilibrium core.

proposal.risk_audit: All three are dimensionless (1/T over 1/T; L2/T3 over L2/T3). f_curv denominator W+S+omega>0 so 100% finite. f_apg_s and f_acc are bounded [-1,1]/[0,1] with denominator |.|+eps>0 except where k=eps=U=0 at wall cells (0/0); expected <1% NaN so passes 99% finite, not constant. f_curv complements I1/I2 via relative S-W difference not absolute magnitude; f_apg_s is signed vs dropped unsigned f_pg_bal; f_acc uses DUDt not in active set, low collinearity with f_noneq/f_sep_int.

features.name: f_curv
features.rationale: Rotation-minus-strain normalized by total shear marks curved/rotation-dominated separated shear vs strain-dominated attached layer.

features.name: f_apg_s
features.rationale: Signed pressure work vs dissipation: +1 strong APG separation, -1 strong FPG acceleration where SST error flips sign.

features.name: f_acc
features.rationale: Acceleration work vs dissipation marks leading-edge acceleration and APG deceleration non-equilibrium missed by Pk/eps alone.
